alexa_dx: quick report from onboarding run: sampleapp batcher produced an empty embedding in a 2-item batch under auth churn. Single curl is fine, only SDK batcher reproduces.

ben_sdk: can you paste the minimal request/response and confirm you're using sampleapp batcher?

alexa_dx: using sampleapp batcher (default). POST /v1/embeddings/batch with inputs ["one", "two"] and forcing token expiry before send. noisy run result: { "results": [ { "embedding": [0.01, -0.02] }, null ] } — no error field.

carla_infra: this matches the auth refresh + partial-retry pattern. when the client refreshes mid-batch the retry wrapper can re-dispatch a fragment; server merges fragments but client-side zipper assumes position mapping and inserts placeholders when slots are missing.

ben_sdk: short-term fix we validated: annotate every input with a stable client_id (nanoid) and have the client remap response items by client_id rather than by array index. also add a single retry of the whole batch if any null/empty entries are seen.

alexa_dx: confirmed: enabling map-by-client-id in the sampleapp eliminates the empty result in 5k forced-expiry runs.

docs_anya: i'll add a troubleshooting blurb to onboarding docs: "If batched embeddings/rerank return null or empty vectors, enable BATCHER_MAP_BY_CLIENT_ID in the sampleapp and upgrade SDKs. This usually indicates auth refresh/retry races." filing DOCS-560.

carla_infra: longer-term: make auth refresh single-flight (block other requests until refresh completes) and change retry wrapper to resend full batches instead of fragments. filing INFRA-935.

ben_sdk: one more parity thing: embeddings endpoint returns field named "embedding" whereas rerank returns "vector" in some responses; normalize zipper to accept either and map to an internal "vec" key. i'll include that in the SDK patch.

ci-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-node/pulls/1401 "batcher: client_id remap, retry-on-null, normalize embedding/vector". CI running.

alexa_dx: thanks everyone. leaving follow-ups on PR and infra ticket. ping me if CI shows any flake. :thumbsup:
